why: The answer mentions "Publish and share" in Studio's header, names "Publish live" as the option that builds and puts the app online, and says publishing needs an invite because a sandbox lasts only two hours. This covers all three must facts, and there are no mustNot items to violate.
The answer says to save the domain once the app is live, and that the section shows an A record and a TXT record to add at the domain provider. It does not mention any price for domains.

The answer includes "Model Context Protocol" and loosely touches on AI assistants using it with a key, but it misses or contradicts other required facts. It never mentions the "/mcp" endpoint; it cites the stdin/stdout command "smithable mcp [dir]" instead. It does not clearly say MCP provides tools for AI assistants, only that it lets agents use a project. It does not say the same key is used, only that "a key" is needed. It also claims the app does not offer MCP, which conflicts with the expected "/mcp" endpoint. Not every required fact is stated.

The answer says an administrator creates keys, that this is done on the users page (the status starter's Team page), and that the key is shown only once. All three required facts are present, and there are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer does not state any of the required facts. It never says Ask is a panel in the app, never mentions questions about the records, and never says it reads only what the person may read. It calls Ask the app's assistant that anyone who signs in can use and says it changes nothing, which is not equivalent to any of those. It also mixes in the "smithable ask" command, which proposes and applies changes and so contradicts the claim that it changes nothing.

The answer does not state either required fact. It never says that pricing and plans are not set, and it never says the beta is free. It only says hosting on smithable.ai is "limited during the private beta," which is not the same as the beta being free. It also adds details the facts don't cover: the software is free and open source, and model calls cost whatever the provider charges. It does avoid the forbidden claims of a monthly price or a per-app price, but missing both required facts makes it incorrect.

The answer mentions Export CSV on list pages, so that must item is met. But it never states the Download everything (.zip) fact, since it names "Download everything (Take it with you)" and does not say it is a .zip. It also never says the download contains code, history, data and uploads. Two of the three required facts are missing.

The answer never says the data is stored in Sweden or that backups are kept in the same region. It describes the /data volume for self-hosted apps and the 2 GB storage limit, and it explicitly says it cannot tell where a hosted app's data is kept. Both required facts are missing.
The answer says yes and mentions Docker, but it never mentions "smithable deploy", which the must list requires. Because one required fact is missing, the answer is not right.

The answer states "No, you do not need an AI model", which covers the "no" fact. It also says everything in Getting started works without one, including every operation, which covers "operations need no model". The mustNot list is empty, so nothing disqualifies it.
The answer explicitly states that the sandbox lasts two hours, which satisfies the only required fact, and there are no prohibited facts to violate.

The answer covers the Import location on the Customers list page and the CSV file requirement, and it does not claim xlsx files are read directly. It never tells the user to save the Excel file as CSV, though, so the must item "save as CSV" is missing. It says Import reads a CSV but never mentions converting or saving from Excel.

The answer states the limit of 10 apps and that each app has both a live and a staging copy, which matches both required facts. No forbidden facts are listed, and the extra reference to the Limits page does not contradict anything.

The answer says it does not know a set limit and that the docs don't state one. It does not give either required fact: 100 recipients a day per app, or 1,000 recipients a month per account. It also implies there is no stated limit, which conflicts with those facts.

The answer states the €2 a month allowance and says changes through forms, in the code, and via built-in rules without a model still work once it runs out. It adds no contradicting claims, and mustNot is empty.

The answer says Slack reaches the app through an incoming Slack entry, which matches "calls in", and says a slash command such as /incident opens an incident, which matches "a slash command makes a record". It does not mention a Connect button that signs in to Slack. It describes a signing secret and a Request URL instead, so the mustNot item is not stated.
The answer says no, the app has no dependency on Smithable, and it mentions the `smithable detach` command. Both required facts are present, and nothing falls under mustNot.

Vastaus mainitsee, että sovelluksen omat tekstit ovat englanniksi ja ruotsiksi, ja että uusi kieli lisätään pyynnöstä. Se ei väitä suomen olevan jo tuettu, vaan sanoo ettei sitä voi vahvistaa valmiiksi.

The answer mentions both required facts: it says to use "Publish and share" in Studio's header and to press "Publish live" under the Publish section. The mustNot list is empty, so nothing is violated.

Svaret anger inte att datan lagras i Sverige och nämner inte att säkerhetskopior finns i samma region. Det säger tvärtom att lagringsplatsen är okänd och tar i stället upp en lagringsgräns på 2 GB. Båda obligatoriska fakta saknas, så svaret är fel.

Vastaus ei kerro, että hinnoittelua ei ole päätetty, eikä sano suoraan, että beta on ilmainen. Se kertoo vain, että ohjelmisto on ilmainen ja avoimen lähdekoodin (Apache-2.0), operaatiot maksavat nolla ja mallikutsujen hinnan määrää palveluntarjoaja. Kuukausihintaa ei mainita, joten mustNot-ehto ei riko, mutta kumpikaan vaadituista faktoista ei toteudu.
The answer mentions the Sign in with Google page of the docs, which covers that must item. It never says the option is found "under Connections", so that required fact is missing.

The answer calls staging a "second copy of your app" alongside the live one, but it never says the copy is separate with its own data. It also says "one secret serves both," which suggests shared resources and does not support the required fact. Nothing in it conveys data isolation, so the must fact is not stated.

The answer mentions "Make a transfer link", a one-time link valid for seven days, and also the "Download everything (.zip)" option, so both required facts are stated. There are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer says Smithable keeps a short description of the app in smithable.yml and generates the code from it, which matches the spec-and-generate fact. It also says routine changes are checked, tested and undoable operations, which matches the undoable-operations fact. No mustNot items exist, so nothing is violated.

The answer says the app workspace has 4 GB of storage, which contradicts the required fact of 2 GB per app. It does say photos share storage with everything else, which loosely covers "uploaded files included", but the wrong storage limit means not every required fact is stated.

Svaret nämner /mcp, men inte att nyckeln kommer från Team-sidan. Det säger i stället att nyckeln visas under steg 2 på sidan Programs and assistants › Connect an assistant, vilket är en annan plats. Därför uppfylls inte kravet "en nyckel från Team-sidan".

The answer omits every required fact. It does not say the data is hosted in Sweden and instead says the docs don't state where data is kept. It does not mention backups in the same region. It does not mention the "Download everything (.zip)" option, only per-list CSV exports. It does not mention a transfer link.
